race.comment: WARRANDYTE ROAD (8) switched to the Reece Goodwin stable recently and has performed well. Carried today's weight to victory last start over 3000m at Yea picnics. Tough veteran who is going well enough to test this opposition. NED KELLY (2) stalked the pace then went home too well for a maiden field over 2000m at Warrnambool last time out. Lightly raced four-year-old with further improvement to come. MERITAGE (6) has arrived in the Tom Dabernig stable since a handy third over this distance at Nowra on 1 November. Dour mare who looks up to winning a race like this. CIRCA (9) showed a glimpse of form last start when he just missed the placings over this distance at Donald. The wins are rare but he should be competitive against this lot. SANIKA (5) caught the eye at Hamilton at his latest appearance 45 days ago. Concerned by that gap between runs but his form is strong compared to most of these.
